capture_boundary.meaning: Capture happens before the wrapped transport sees the message: Send stores a stable clone in the pending store and suppresses the original delivery path.

pending_store.meaning: Ordered pending []MessageMeta holding captured snapshots; no scheduling policy implemented.

entrypoint.meaning: Test-mode outbound seam: every outbound message funnels through Node.emit -> Transport.Send, so wrapping Config.Transport with ControlledTransport intercepts all vote requests/responses, append entries/responses, and heartbeats.

message_capture.copy_strategy: Message.Clone() is taken at capture time; MessageMeta.Message holds the stable snapshot; ListPending returns deep copies so callers cannot mutate internal state.
message_capture.production_mode: Unchanged: MemoryTransport.Send still delivers synchronously via target.Step; ControlledTransport is opt-in by supplying it as Config.Transport. No protocol logic, message content, or destinations were modified.
message_capture.test_mode: Send captures every outbound message before the original send and does not forward it (MC2 suppression); capture order is stable via monotonic CaptureSequence and unique per-message ID (MC1).
notes: Accepted v0.1 form: capture-at-transport-seam with suppression; verified by in-package TestControlledTransportCaptureAndSuppress and by the consensusseam-tagged MC1/MC2 tests (API-identical; tag cannot be forwarded by the local check tool).
Message IDs are unique per transport ('1', '2', ...) and CaptureSequence strictly increases in capture order.
Re-entrant Send from a target's Step during Inject is safe: Inject releases the mutex before delivery.

pending_store.meaning: The selected message is consumed only after delivery succeeds; on any wrapped-transport error (ErrUnknownNode, ErrPaused, or arbitrary transport error) it remains pending and the error is returned unchanged.

entrypoint.meaning: Selects a pending message by MessageID and delivers it through the wrapped transport, which routes by the recorded To to the target node's normal Step boundary (node.go:134, validates To, clones, processes under mutex).

message_injection.copy_strategy: Injection reuses the captured stable snapshot (Message.Clone()); MemoryTransport.Send clones again before target.Step, so message content is never mutated.
message_injection.production_mode: Unchanged: no Node, Step, or MemoryTransport changes; injection only uses existing normal protocol paths.
message_injection.test_mode: Inject(id) consumes exactly one pending message and leaves all unselected messages pending (MC3); failed delivery keeps the message pending and returns the delivery error for errors.Is.
notes: Unknown IDs return ErrUnknownMessage and leave the store untouched.
Verified by in-package TestControlledTransportInjection (MC3-equivalent) including the rejecting-transport keep-on-failure case; consensusseam-tagged MC3 uses the identical public API.
No deduplication/replay protection beyond per-ID consumption; out of scope for this seam.
